_comment: TempoSoul 根域 apex→www 301 · 备选 Redirect Rule（线程 h7 落盘，未在 CF 创建）。与 public/_redirects 二选一；推荐以 public/_redirects 为准，本文件作仪表盘/Terraform 对照。文档: docs/governance/2026-09-12-root-domain-301.md
_terraform_example: resource "cloudflare_ruleset" "apex_to_www" { name = "apex-to-www"; kind = "zone"; phase = "http_request_dynamic_redirect"; rules { action = "redirect"; action_parameters { status_code = 301; from_value { preserve_query_string = true; target_url { value = concat("https://www.temposoul.com", http.request.uri.path) } } }; expression = "(http.host eq \"temposoul.com\")" } }
